title: Algae-Abundant Health Present In Blue-Green Algae
excerpt: Super Blue-Green Algae by Cell-Tech is a food, not a supplement, even though it comes in a bottle.
content:
Super Blue-Green Algae by Cell-Tech is a food, not a supplement, even though it comes in a bottle.

Although blue-green algae grows in all lakes and ponds, it grows densely, abundantly and without pollution in Klamath Lake in Klamath Falls, Oregon.

Super Blue-Green Algae is a complete and balanced protein and has been found to be effective in reducing radiation and heavy metal exposure in the body. It also adds minerals to our systems, especially trace minerals, lacking because of the depleted state of the soil.

Although there are other algaes, such as spirulina, Hippocrates Institute Director of Education Richard Salome says that blue-green algae’s cellular structure makes it less dense and therefore easier for the body to use. Blue-green algae crosses the brain barrier, while other algaes cannot, and this phenomenon may be the reason that it has been found effective in the treatment of Alzheimer’s disease.

“It is a tremendous rebalancer of body chemistry,” says Salome, “and a great source of energy.” He says that it is possibly the highest vegetarian source of B-12 available, and high in beta-carotene.

Viktoras Kulvinkas, author of Survival Into the 21st Century credits Super Blue-Green Algae with restoring balance to his life. “ I gradually moved from food addiction to living a more responsible, life-positive lifestyle,” he says./ known for his intensive workshops, he says that he has given some of his best lectures while taking Omega Sun, the Cell-Tech product that supports better thinking. Alpha Sun is more specifically recommended for the body.

Guests at Hippocrates have reported that when they use Super Blue-Green Algae they experience more energy, clearer thinking, need less sleep and have more stamina. Athletes report improved performance.

Hippocrates Institute recommends blue-green algae as a vital and permanent part of a health and healing program. Research on participants at the Institute has shown that during the past six years of its use as part of the Hippocrates program, this super-food greatly augments the phenomenal results of the living foods diet.
